notes.title: July 30, 2017 update
notes.content:
Just fixed a big game breaking bug (that i could have sworn i fixed in a previous build... I guess I forgot to save after compiling... blah)... Anyway, if anyone's game ever freaked out after the Ferry witch boss battle, that's all cleared up. Also, reincluded  Joy to Key in the folder... Somehow that went missing as well.  

There's also a super secret God mode, if you can figure it out....

Thanks to Dr. Von MonkeyStein for finding that Bug during his let's play series.

notes.title: New version update !
notes.content:
Just made a few tweaks and updates. There is now a Quick Save feature, which allows you to save your progress, although you when resuming play, you will automatically be warped back to the last Save-O-Potty that you used, But you'll keep all the items, kills, etc. 

Also fixed that obnoxious pause menu thing, where if you click outside of the game window to adjust volume, or whatever else, it would unpause... Well, that's fixed now. 

Of course, which each new bug fix, there's always the possibility of unintended side effects... so, if you see something funky... Please lemme know.
